questions.question: Saga pattern trong microservices giải quyết vấn đề gì?

options.A: Distributed transactions: chuỗi local transactions với compensating transactions khi fail

questions.explanation: Saga: không có distributed 2PC → dùng chuỗi local transactions. Choreography: events trigger next steps. Orchestration: central saga orchestrator. Compensating transactions: undo completed steps khi failure.

questions.question: Circuit Breaker pattern trong microservices?

options.A: Detect failures, open circuit khi failure threshold reached → fast fail, prevent cascade. Auto reset sau timeout

questions.explanation: Circuit Breaker states: Closed (normal) → Open (failing, fast fail) → Half-Open (probe). Resilience4j/Hystrix implement. Prevent cascade failures: 1 slow service không kéo chết toàn bộ system.

questions.question: Kafka vs RabbitMQ — khi nào chọn cái nào?

options.A: Kafka: high throughput, event log, replay events, stream processing. RabbitMQ: complex routing, task queues, request-reply
options.D: RabbitMQ cho events, Kafka cho tasks

questions.explanation: Kafka: append-only log, consumer groups, replay, millions/sec. RabbitMQ: AMQP, exchanges (direct/fanout/topic), flexible routing, TTL, dead-letter queue. Kafka: event sourcing, audit log. RabbitMQ: work queues, microservice messaging.
